description: Change a multi-state object: new state, delete, rename, reorder or show a state, add or paste items into a state, release one or all states to objects, Hidden Until Triggered (Object States panel)

operation.description: new_state (from ids, or empty), delete_state, rename_state, move_state, show_state (make it the visible state), add_to_state (move items in: Add Objects to Visible State), paste_into_state (copies of items), release_state (Release State to Objects), release_all (Release All States to Objects), set_hidden (Hidden Until Triggered)

state.description: The state, by name; for add_to_state and paste_into_state the visible state if omitted

name: edit_object_states
title: Edit Object States
